Alone in Holy Land
Hi, when I came to Israel, 27 years ago, I didn't know what a storm I would create in my soul. I had problems coping with such a big move, with living in a country I felt didn't want me. And so I did what i knew how: I wrote. I started a blog where I wrote about my journey -** Alone In Holy Land**. After a while I stopped writing, but I am back again...

After many years, blog posts, silence, and returning to writing again**, *****Alone in Holy Land*** finally became a book.

It gathers pieces I wrote during different years of my life in Israel — about immigration, loneliness, motherhood, absurdity, survival, memory, and trying to belong.

I decided to make it available free on my blog, because that is where these texts were born in the first place. 

So, if you want to read about the trial and tribulations of an expat, go to my blog. 

[https://aloneinholyland.blogspot.com/2026/05/alone-in-holy-land-book.html](https://aloneinholyland.blogspot.com/2026/05/alone-in-holy-land-book.html)
